Subject: [Dixielandjazz] New John Pertters Trio Video on Jazz Legends & 	YouTube

Hi Folks,
I'm working on a new DVD and CD box set of a trio session I recorded in 
March with the brilliant James Evans on clarinet and the incredible 
youge Italian pianist Paolo Alderighi.

The material is mostly based on the Goodman trio style.
I've been getting to grips with video editing - using two cameras with 
the audio dubbed on to the sountrack from my professional hard disc 
machine.
Take a peek

http://jazzlegends.ning.com/video/video/show?id=2137845%3AVideo%3A1061

or
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B4g1YPXwG3k

Keep swinging
-- 
John Petters
www.traditional-jazz.com
Amateur Radio Station G3YPZ
